tests.name: Dried blood spot Hepatitis C RNA screening
tests.description: This service is designed for those patients on whom it is difficult to obtain venous blood, especially for intra venous drug users. Contact the laboratory for supply of postal packs containing all necessary items for using this service. Paediatric/infant packs are available on request

specimen.special_precautions: Ensure blood spot has dried and submit with desiccant pouch enclosed. Do not send back used/unused lancets.

analysis.interferences: Spots too small, not all spots filled with blood

turnaround.provisional_raw: 5 days Turn round time to final result (working days): 7 days

result_format.basis: organism, antigen or susceptibility report rather than a measured quantity

tests.name: Hepatitis A total antibody (IgG and IgM)

specimen.transport: Ambient temperature via porter, courier, Royal Mail or DX compliant with IATA packing instruction 650
specimen.special_precautions: If processing is delayed, refrigeration is preferable to storage at ambient temperature. Delays of over 48hr are undesirable.

analysis.interferences: Haemolysis Assay interference and generation of anomalous results can occur when a patients' sample contains:  Heterophile antibodies  Animal serum products (from routine exposure to animals)  Human mouse monoclonal antibodies (patients who receive  Preparations of mouse monoclonal antibodies for diagnosis or therapy)

result_format.basis: organism, antigen or susceptibility report rather than a measured quantity
